tldr: Chiron transiting the 7th house: a long healing chapter around partners, clients, agreements, and one-to-one dynamics.
body: Chiron moving through the 7th house can reopen old material around partners, clients, agreements, and one-to-one dynamics. This is usually a long season, not a quick event, and it asks for patient work with the sore place rather than a rushed fix. The wound surfaces through partners; you draw wounded or wounding others, and relationship is where it shows.
business: For a year or more, the Chiron wound works through partners, clients, agreements, and one-to-one dynamics. You help others heal through and within relationship.
shadow: Healing partners instead of yourself, or expecting them to fix the wound.
advice: Tend the sore spot in the 7th house deliberately. Work with partners, clients, agreements, and one-to-one dynamics as a healing chapter, not a crisis to fix fast.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Derived from authored Chiron house placement material.
